names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 30 aprilie, «Sfântul Apostol Iacob, fratele Sfântului Apostol Ioan Evanghelistul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος αδελφός Ιωάννου του Θεολόγου», with the rank word and the kinship clause left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 30. април ст. ст., „Св. апостол Јаков.“, with Св. left off as no rank and апостол left off as the `apostle` this folder already carries in `types` and `honorific.js` composes back. The heading carries no kinship clause and no epithet, so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form; „Син Заведејев и брат Јованов“ is the body's first sentence, and this corpus keeps such a clause in the English display name and not in a name form. Four other folders already hold the same bare form; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

feast.note: Doxologia keeps him twice: its calendar prints him on 30 aprilie and again on 30 iunie — «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli». One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is the day this folder was read from and the second day is recorded here. The 30 iunie line is the Synaxis of the Twelve, which names each apostle in turn. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Iacob, fratele Sfântului Apostol Ioan Evanghelistul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος αδελφός Ιωάννου του Θεολόγου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same apostle: son of Zebedee and Salome, elder brother of John the Evangelist, of Bethsaida in Galilee, a fisherman with his brother and his father and many hired men, with their own boat and Peter for a partner. **The Greek adds a year the folder did not have**: «οι άρχοντες των Ιουδαίων, οι οποίοι, το έτος 44 μ.Χ. τον συνέλαβαν και τον αποκεφάλισαν, ως αμνόν, με διαταγή του Ηρώδου του Αγρίππα», beheaded in the year 44 by order of Herod Agrippa, and the page heads him «(; - 44)»; that year is now in `dates` and no year of birth is printed. The Greek also sets out what the two sons of thunder alone witnessed — the Transfiguration, the raising of the daughter of Jairus, the hours of prayer and agony in Gethsemane — and reads the request made through their mother as a misunderstanding of the Messiah's mission which Christ corrected with «Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε». **Three of the page's four hymns are stored and one is not**: the apolytikion in Ἦχος γ’ and the kontakion in Ἦχος β’ are proper and name him, and the short «Ἀπόστολε ἅγιε Ἰάκωβε, πρέσβευε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ» in Ἦχος πλ. δ’ is the common of an apostle with his name set into it and was left, as were the megalynarion, the oikos and the kathisma, which are none of them a kind this corpus holds. The existing Romanian feast note already records doxologia's second day for him, 30 iunie, the Synaxis of the Twelve; saint.gr links the same synaxis from this page and that is not a second row either.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.05.2026 (30. април ст. ст.) — „Св. апостол Јаков.“

attestations.note: **The day is Julian 30 April, the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek calendars keep him on**, so nothing moved and no second-day note is owed. This is the third account read for this folder, and it is the one that **supplies what the Romanian life elided**: that life has the contest with the hired sorcerer „fill the middle“ and does not say how it ended, where this book does — „Но и Хермоген, и Филип, ученик Хермогенов, бише побеђени силом истине, коју Јаков проповедаше, и обојица се крстише“, the magician and his disciple both overcome by the power of the truth James preached, and both baptized. **A year widened and neither reading chosen**: „Пострада Јаков свети 45. год. у Јерусалиму“ against saint.gr's «το έτος 44 μ.Χ.» and its heading «(; - 44)», so `death` is now 44–45 and reads „44 or 45“. This book is also the first of the three to name **Jerusalem** as the place of the martyrdom; no `locations` were taken for it, because the folder has none and a located saint brings `map-span.test.mjs` into play. **The refusal of the day is in this entry**: Јосија, the suborned slanderer who repented and was beheaded with him, took no folder — the reasons are in the batch's commit message. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion, so this folder gains no hymn from it.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 30. април ст. ст.: „Пострада Јаков свети 45. год. у Јерусалиму.“ — the forty-fifth year, where saint.gr has «οι άρχοντες των Ιουδαίων, οι οποίοι, το έτος 44 μ.Χ. τον συνέλαβαν και τον αποκεφάλισαν» and heads him «(; - 44)». Two sources one year apart; neither was chosen and the interval carries both. doxologia's life gives no year at all and dates him only by Herod. No year of birth is printed on any of the three pages.

hymns.text: Γόνος ἅγιος, βροντῆς ὑπάρχων, κατεβρόντησας, τὴ οἰκουμένη, τὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος Ἰάκωβε κένωσιν, καὶ τὸ ποτήριον τούτου ἐξέπιες, μαρτυρικῶς ἐναθλήσας Ἀπόστολε, ὅθεν πάντοτε, ἐξαίτει τοὶς σὲ γεραίρουσι, πταισμάτων ἱλασμὸν καὶ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, on the page of «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος αδελφός Ιωάννου του Θεολόγου»

english.text: Being a holy child of thunder, thou didst thunder out to the whole world the self-emptying of the Saviour, O James, and thou didst drink His cup, contending as a martyr, O apostle. Wherefore ask always for those who honour thee the pardon of their sins and great mercy.

hymns.text: Φωνῆς θεϊκῆς, ἀκούσας προσκαλούσης σε, ἀγάπην πατρός, παρεῖδες καὶ προσέδραμες, τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰάκωβε, μετά καί τοῦ συγγόνου σου ἔνδοξε, μεθ᾽ οὗ καὶ ἠξιώθης ἰδεῖν, Κυρίου τήν θείαν Μεταμόρφωσιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τά ἄνω ζητῶν, on the page of «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος αδελφός Ιωάννου του Θεολόγου»

english.text: Hearing the divine voice that called thee, thou didst overlook a father's love and run to Christ, O James, together with thy brother, O glorious one, with whom thou wast counted worthy to see the divine Transfiguration of the Lord.
